source.description:
## PROBLEM
Core must not publish a production launcher against xtmux behavior that exists only on a branch.

## SUCCESS
Publish a backward-compatible xtmux compatibility release containing the accepted K3/K4 adapter and lifecycle work, before the Core launcher release.

## SCOPE
Versioning, changelog, package publication, compatibility metadata, and post-publish install verification for xtmux.

## NON_GOALS
Do not publish Core or Specialists, change release order, or introduce new optional capabilities.

## CONSTRAINTS
This issue executes only after K5 promotion authorization. The release must remain compatible with the current Core line and expose no dependency on unpublished Core behavior beyond an already published contract package if required.

## VALIDATION
Verify package contents, registry version, clean install/update, EVAL-01 fixtures, backward compatibility, and the exact version handed to the Core release bead.

## OUTPUT
A published xtmux version and immutable release evidence consumed by Core K6.
source.title: K6-xtmux — Publish the backward-compatible Codex compatibility release
